integrity: The exact Gram determinant, analytic extremal proof, and checker agree. Numerical root values are approximations. The originality comparison is based on inspected relevant primary material and searches, without independent publication-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Only four ordered axis-aligned corners of an L2-normalized Gaussian are optimized at fixed small positive symplectic area. Maximizer uniqueness modulo axis swap is proved only for sufficiently small area; no all-area transition, minimum-eigenvalue optimization, or arbitrary four-point optimum is asserted. Older equivalent coherent-state design results may exist.
title: Asymmetric D-optimality of small-area Gaussian Gabor rectangles
